stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the token persistence schema including fields for token_id, hashed_token, created_at, expires_at, rotated_from, revoked_at, and scope. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB utilities and audit logging patterns.
stories.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No formal token lifecycle schema defined

stories.title: Token Rotation Policy Enforcement
stories.description: Implement configurable rotation policies including max token age, forced rotation intervals, and one-time-use rotation chains. Ensure rotated tokens are linked and prior tokens invalidated according to policy.
stories.evidence: RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-002; GAP: No rotation policy enforcement exists

stories.title: Token Audit Logging Integration
stories.description: Extend existing audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, revocation, and authentication failures. Ensure logs align with GPTReader audit patterns and support traceability for security reviews.
